contract.objective: Quantify whether withholding the one identity-ambiguous original action changes the named relationship, selection, weighting and completion conclusions, without replacing canonical receipts
contract.treatment: Delete only all three representation rows of each of the five specified original capture keys, their matching assignment rows and this action's two plan-membership rows. Preserve every surviving field, original split, action/temporal keys and plan interval. Do not add art002e009301 or any new candidate family, merge identities, rehash splits or rebuild temporal clusters.
contract.analysis: Baseline and conditional subset use the frozen Stage 11R, 10W, 11U and 11V pure calculations, plus an in-memory composition of Stage 11T's unchanged weighting/overlap primitives. Require the baseline metrics to reproduce their canonical receipts before interpreting any delta.
contract.oracle: Exact deletion membership and source hashes; full native-ID relationship parity across input tables; original baseline replay; independent counts/ratios from rows; no-op control; wrong action/partial representation/wrong assignment/addition/field mutation rejection; shared-state versus changed-case numeric disposition.
contract.stop: Stop before writing on a source, baseline, deletion-scope, field-parity or table-join mismatch. The sensitivity is conditional, not a probability estimate, physical correction or comprehensive archive audit.
